He Found You First

Crested Hawk-Eagle · Udawalawe National Park, Sri Lanka

Take a moment with this picture. Look closely. Can you find him?

He is there, a Crested Hawk-Eagle, one of the hunters of Sri Lanka's skies. Like every good predator, he knows how to disappear. His feathers are a camouflage coat, colored to match the world around him, so he melts into the scene like he is a part of it.

And he chooses his place carefully. Predators like him pick the spots where they blend in best, because from there they can watch for their prey without ever being noticed.

That is what makes this picture so special to me. You can barely spot the bird at all. But while your eyes are still searching for him, he is already looking straight at you.

You may be trying to find him. He found you first.
